records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: As of July 30, 2022 and January 29, 2022, there was $13,016,000 and $11,096,000, respectively, of total unrecognized compensation expense related to unvested restricted stock awards, which had a remaining weighted-average vesting period of 2.6 years and 2.3 years, respectively.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The total compensation expense during the three and six months ended July 30, 2022 was $1,403,000 and $2,006,000, respectively, compared to $1,597,000 and $1,880,000, respectively, for the three and six months ended July 31, 2021.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The compensation expense recognized for the 15% discount given under the Employee Stock Purchase Plan was approximately $26,000 and $26,000 for the six months ended July 30, 2022 and July 31, 2021, respectively.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Sales purchased on the Company’s proprietary credit card for the three and six months ended July 30, 2022 were $5.8 million and $11.5 million, respectively, compared to $4.8 million and $9.2 million for the three and six months ended July 31, 2021, respectively.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: In particular, the Company is subject to the continued effects of disruption in the global supply chain, including as a result of government responses to COVID-19 surges in the foreign countries where our merchandise is produced, inflation and its impact on our cost of products, transportation, wage rates and other operating costs, as well as, the impact on our customers’ disposable incomes, and the availability of workers at our stores, distribution center and corporate office.
